blockers.description: PROD refresh BROKEN since ~09:17 Almaty 2026-05-29 by DuckDB ART-index corruption on activities table for activity 18694535582 ('Failed to delete all rows from index. Only deleted 0 out of 1 rows' -> DB invalidated). Mirror stale ~6h+. READS STILL WORK. Pre-existing — broke ~4h before this session started, NOT caused by our restarts.
blockers.workaround: Compaction (COPY FROM DATABASE) rebuilds clean index and fixes it (proven), but re-corrupted within ~30min after a compact -> recurring trigger (DuckDB corrupts index on transaction RevertCommit).

human_actions_pending.action: Choose remediation path for broken refresh
human_actions_pending.context: Upgrade ruled out empirically (1.5.3, 1.5.4.dev2, 1.6.0.dev12 all FATAL). Compaction fixes the index but may not hold. Durable = remove ART index (also fixes bloat).

decisions.decision: Tasks 12+13 shipped: admin catchup (merged backfill cmds), admin compact (COPY FROM DATABASE). NO auto-compact in catchup — orthogonal ops.
DuckDB upgrade does NOT fix the ART fatal — ruled out by testing 1.5.3 / 1.5.4.dev2 / 1.6.0.dev12 against a snapshot; all FATAL on the failing upsert.
decisions.rationale: 1.5.3 is latest stable; fixes for this RevertCommit index-corruption are in unreleased DuckDB PR #21986.

decisions.decision: Root cause of BOTH the refresh fatal AND the disk bloat = ART indexes (PRIMARY KEY) on hot tables.
decisions.rationale: Empirically: corrupt index -> fatal; compaction rebuilds clean -> works. Bloat = ART blocks not reclaimed.

decisions.decision: Created protected read-only backup at ~/backups/mcp-strava-safe/ (strava-clean-...duckdb verified: 604 activities, 2,684,891 streams, survives upsert; + strava-raw-...duckdb).
decisions.rationale: Data-preservation hard constraint; ~2 days to refetch. MUST NOT delete until normal function restored.

next_action: Get user decision on remediation (task 17): compact prod to unbreak refresh + watch via the new observability for recurrence, vs durable ART-index removal. BEFORE any destructive op, verify the safe backup at ~/backups/mcp-strava-safe/ is intact. Do NOT delete that backup.
context_notes: Long investigation session. Mirror DATA is intact (only the ART index is corrupt; reads work). The expensive 2.68M-row stream data is safe + backed up. Methodological lesson this session: I repeatedly asserted plausible-but-wrong root causes (reopen amplification, fact-table churn, summary churn) that the USER correctly refuted via timeline/evidence; only the from-compacted-baseline experiments + version A/B test were decisive. Resuming agent: form hypothesis -> run the decisive measurement BEFORE concluding; start growth experiments from a COMPACTED (free=0) copy; minimize prod restarts; grep logs for errors/fatals first.
